ValidationRule.description: Blocker tasks cannot be due on the last day of a month, on a Sunday, or before the end of last month.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, 'Blocker'), NOT(ISBLANK(Due_Date__c)), OR( Due_Date__c = ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(Due_Date__c), MONTH(Due_Date__c), 1), 1) - 1, Due_Date__c < TODAY() - DAY(TODAY()), WEEKDAY(Due_Date__c) = 1 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Blocker tasks cannot be due on month end, on a Sunday, or in the past.
